name: Demacia Cup Global 2027
overview: Demacia Cup Global 2027 is an international postseason League of Legends event closing the 2027 season, intended for strong teams that miss the World Championship. Organized by Riot Games, it takes place in Berlin, Germany, from November 24 to December 2, 2027, with a total prize pool of USD 500,000. It is not equal in prestige to Worlds. The qualified teams and format have not been announced.
